mu_name_from: Devias's object slot 14, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object3/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under a dv_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing as nr_ is for Noria: assets/textures is one flat pool, and 39 of Object3's sheet names are already in it.
material_note: blockhead: a snow-capped wooden fence rail - read off the art as rock and wrong: seen standing it is the posts and rails that line the town's roads, snow along the top rail.
why_this_one: 184 of them, the third commonest: the snowy wooden fences along the town's roads.
effects_note: No arm in MuMain's WD_2DEVIAS switches: static, unlit, nothing added.
